source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 27 May 1939, p. 9 ("Local Elections: Surprise in Armagh County Council Contest"); Portadown News, 3 June 1939, p. 8; nominations from the Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Labour to Oppose Nationalists: Armagh Co. Council Elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every figure read from the two page images

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1939: nominations received by T. E. Reid, M.B.E., 25 April 1939; contests in Armagh and Crossmaglen, polled 25 May 1939. Polled 25 May 1939. Hanratty was the retiring member; Morris was General Secretary of the Armagh Federation of Labour. The Belfast News-Letter prints 728 and 579 with a majority of 147; the Portadown News prints 728 and 577 with a majority of 149. Both majorities imply 726 for Hanratty. 25 spoilt.
